basic_info.chief_complaint: Pain in left lower back tooth.

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: Pain in left lower back tooth.

treatment_plan.notes: Avoid acidic foods within a week and avoid hot and cold stimulation. Maintain oral hygiene as directed by your doctor and rinse with mouthwash. Regular re-examination and follow-up treatment if any discomfort occurs.

source_handle: 38 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. 2% lidocaine block anesthesia, incision, gingival separation, gap expansion, loosening, forceps removal, and compression to stop bleeding. Stitch.
